newsitem.title: POLAND: Several investors bid for Tonsil stake.
newsitem.headline: Several investors bid for Tonsil stake.

text.p: Poland's treasury ministry is examining several offers for its 8.39-percent stake in Polish speaker systems maker Tonsil SA, a treasury ministry spokeswoman said.
Barbara Hajduk told Reuters that the ministry was likely to finish studying the offers by January 10, 1997.
"The offers, which are few, are being considered. The deadline is January 10, 1997, but we expect they could be examined earlier," she said.
The ministry, which has a 26.78-percent stake in Tonsil, earlier said it would prefer investors who are not Tonsil's competitors.

The remaining Tonsil's shareholders are: Japan's Tohoku Pioneer Electronic Corporation, which has a 13.34-percent stake in the company, Polish state-owned bank PKO BP, which has 9.08 percent and Bank Slaski, which holds 6.5 percent.
